name: lumi-skill-design-studio-pack
description: Focused space-planning and interior-design workflows for briefs, drawing intake, IFC/Revit review, FF&E schedules, site surveys, and visualization.

lumi.setupNote: Core tools work without API keys. Optional managed connectors add local PaddleOCR plus read-only IFC and Revit review.

limitations: The tools analyze supplied project facts and prepare plans; they do not alter drawings, applications, or external systems.
